en: Black‑and‑white image of the entrance to a corner wine and delicatessen shop housed in an ornate stone building. Two women in early 20th‑century clothing and hats stand in the doorway. The facade is covered with painted and printed signs advertising wines, delicacies, and imported goods. The text on the signs is predominantly Swedish, and some boards list types of wines and foreign products. The overall look suggests an old commercial street scene, likely reproduced as a historic postcard.
